jammed.name: Jammed
jammed.effect: Target cannot use protocols (CHARGE spending blocked).

overloaded.name: Overloaded
overloaded.effect: Target takes +50% damage from all sources.

shielded.name: Shielded
shielded.effect: Target gains +4 Defense and immunity to the next condition applied. Consumed on use.

blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.effect: Target's LOS reduced to 1 cell. Ranged attacks take -4.

immobilized.name: Immobilized
immobilized.effect: Target cannot move (move action consumed). Can still act with AP.

corroded.name: Corroded
corroded.effect: Target loses 2 Defense per turn (cumulative, min Defense 2).

marked.name: Marked
marked.effect: Target is visible to all hostiles regardless of LOS. Hostiles gain +2 to attack rolls against MARKED target.

panicked.name: Panicked
panicked.effect: Target must move away from nearest hostile on its turn (forced retreat). Cannot attack.

burning.name: Burning
burning.effect: Target takes d6 damage at the start of its turn for 3 turns. Stacks (renewing duration).
